title: Decent treats, too long to wait.
text: My order took nearly a month to receive from the day I ordered it. I had to cancel the subscription before it even arrived or I would've been charged for the next month. However, my dog really enjoyed all but one of the treats, she ended up giving to her neighbor friend. That's impressive for my husky, she turns her nose up at almost everything. She's a very picky lady. If you're looking for a variety of chews to try out and don't mind waiting, I say for the price it's a pretty good deal. I do have to admit though, I'm a bit disappointed, I read previous reviews about them sending a ton of poop bags and didn't get a single roll. >.< I would've much rather had the poop bags than the stuffed pizza slice toy I didn't give to her because she would've destroyed it in 2 seconds flat.
label: neutral
